about: The public trust table of the URTC bootloaders in source form: which public keys a bootloader accepts to sign an application image. Only public values are written here; no secret ever is. tools/image_trust.py builds the table from this file and checks that a compiled bootloader holds exactly that table. The image-signing key is not the key that signs release assets (keys/registry.json).

dev.about: Bench builds. The seed of this key is public (urtc_common.image_sig.DEV_SEED): a bootloader with this table is never an official one.

release.about: Official builds. The image-signing key (current) and the reserved next key; the private halves stay outside every repository.
